profile.name: GSIOC兼容实验室仪器
profile.description: 这类设备是支持 GSIOC 串行通信协议的实验室仪器，通常通过 RS-422/485 总线连接，并可在同一总线上按单元地址进行选择与控制。它们常见于实验室自动化场景，用于样品处理、流体输送或其他需要串行联机控制的仪器系统。
profile.description_en: This device class comprises laboratory instruments that support the GSIOC serial communication protocol, typically over an RS-422/485 bus. They can be addressed and controlled by unit ID on a shared serial bus and are commonly used in lab automation setups for sample handling, fluid transfer, or other instrument control tasks.
